title: Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: National Security Activities
reviewTopics: Paris Economic Summit; Sherpa process; Toronto Economic Summit; Transition planning
reviewFocus: The transition briefing book contains a four-page paper on the Economic Summits, a two-page chronology of preparations for the 1988 Toronto Summit, and a transition calendar extending into July 1989. The paper recommends early decisions about organization and U.S. objectives for the Paris Summit and records State-Treasury friction in the Sherpa process.
reviewKeyExtent: released copies of the 4-page Economic Summits paper and 2-page Toronto chronology are present; the master withdrawal sheet shows their former (b)(1) restrictions crossed out
archivalLocator: George H.W. Bush Library, Bush Presidential Records, National Security Council, H-Files, IF Transition Files, OA/ID 99015–003, Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: National Security Activities.

title: Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: NSC Policy Issues
reviewTopics: Uruguay Round; International debt; Paris Economic Summit; Trade Act of 1988; IMF; EC 1992; Japan; Technology and competitiveness
reviewFocus: The six-page International Economic Affairs Directorate paper is a compact transition agenda for the incoming administration. It covers Paris Summit organization, Trade Act authorities, the Uruguay Round, Japan rice and semiconductors, Section 232 petitions, the EC meat-hormone dispute and 1992 single market, East-West credits, middle-income and African debt, IMF quotas, energy, and technology competitiveness.
reviewKeyExtent: the released 6-page International Economic Affairs Directorate paper is present and its former (b)(1) entry is crossed out; a separate 5-page International Programs/Technology Affairs paper remains represented by a (b)(1) withdrawal sheet
archivalLocator: George H.W. Bush Library, Bush Presidential Records, National Security Council, H-Files, IF Transition Files, OA/ID 99015–005, Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: NSC Policy Issues.

title: Reagan-Bush Transition Briefing Book: Background on NSC Organization and Administration
chapter: Transition Economies and International Economic Strategy
reviewTopics: NSC transition; International Economic Affairs Directorate; Interagency process
reviewFocus: The covering memorandum and briefing book define the outgoing NSC's international-economic portfolio, including trade, debt, multilateral development banks, energy, the Paris Summit, East-West economic relations, and technology-transfer responsibilities. Use this as institutional and authorship context; the more substantive policy-issues briefing in NAID 470760859 should normally control documentary selection.
reviewKeyExtent: the released November 9 covering memorandum and directorate descriptions are present; two unrelated attachments totaling 11 pages remain identified on the withdrawal sheet
